title: Reaching Somebody
label: ch:ml-message
canDo: I can name the telephone, a letter, the post, e-mail and the internet, and say an address aloud as far as the stop.

payoff.summary: From cold: five ways of reaching somebody, and the new letter that opens the first.
payoff.note: FIVE SPANISH POINTS BEHIND ONE MALAYALAM POINT -- A1-NE09-01..03, NE09-06 and NE11-01 -- made LEX-38 the largest single payoff left in the file. Word-bounded checking confirmed that kattu, a letter, was not previously taught: its characters only appeared inside akattu, inside. The chapter turns that overlap into an explicit reading contrast. kattu, thapaal, imeyil and inrarneRRu reuse already owned script. phooN now prints as ഫോൺ because HL-C398 added source-verified chillu NN to the inventory; ML-S148 teaches the previously unopened ഫ immediately before the word. The e-mail lesson pays off chapter 108's full stop by using it in an address.
